THIRD-PARTY SOFTWARE — AUSTRALIS v0.10.24

The optional bundled loader is the unmodified ACPreloader.zip asset from
AnchorChain V1.1.0:
https://github.com/SeaPower-Modders/AnchorChain/releases/tag/V1.1.0
https://github.com/SeaPower-Modders/AnchorChain/releases/download/V1.1.0/ACPreloader.zip
SHA-256: 6fe07835a56e0e401af580cfb9167cd460973f066c162f7e69dfc256b1f9a90d
All bundled loader DLLs are byte-identical to that asset. They are separate
from the Australis controller. These notices do not license Sea Power or
Unity; no game/Unity assemblies, developer reference assemblies or offline
test DLLs are included in this third-party folder.

AnchorChain Preloader — MIT
  Distributed in AnchorChain release V1.1.0. The preloader's embedded
  assembly version is 1.0.0.0; its product metadata identifies source commit
  6983e634922d31cb44a5ce6f19aea09769261261. The release tag resolves to
  28d225be917533fcc25e19cf8f25ac44010f8abd, whose license file is LICENSE.md.
  Copyright (c) 2025 SeaPower-Modders. Full text: AnchorChain-MIT.txt.
  https://github.com/SeaPower-Modders/AnchorChain/tree/V1.1.0

BepInEx — 5.4.23.2 — MIT
  Covers BepInEx.dll, BepInEx.Preloader.dll and their XML documentation.
  The versions were read from the bundled assemblies. The exact upstream
  v5.4.23.2 tag resolves to eda9ae89dd2c8bc9c7824d3658c13bcff4e5336e;
  its LICENSE is MIT. Copyright (c) 2018 Bepis.
  Full text: BepInEx-MIT.txt.
  https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/tree/v5.4.23.2
  The AnchorChain V1.1.0 README describes bundled BepInEx as LGPL v2.1.
  That statement conflicts with the exact BepInEx release's MIT LICENSE.
  This package uses the verified version-specific upstream license. The
  LGPL-licensed component in this loader is UnityDoorstop, below.

BepInEx.Harmony and compatibility shims — MIT
  BepInEx.Harmony.dll 2.0.0.0, HarmonyXInterop.dll 1.0.0.0 and the
  0Harmony20.dll compatibility assembly 2.0.0.0 are supplied by the
  BepInEx.Harmony submodule pinned by BepInEx 5.4.23.2 to commit
  0d24abfed64596ee88b4242b9c7e3daa849d6d28. The upstream 2019 copyright
  notice is preserved exactly, including its blank author field.
  Full text: BepInEx.Harmony-MIT.txt; also see Harmony-LICENSE.txt for
  the original Harmony code attribution.
  https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx.Harmony/tree/0d24abfed64596ee88b4242b9c7e3daa849d6d28

UnityDoorstop — 4.3.0 — GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1
  winhttp.dll; its product version and .doorstop_version both report 4.3.0.
  Full text: UnityDoorstop-LICENSE.txt.
  An unmodified complete source archive from the official v4.3.0 commit,
  including license and build scripts, is provided beside these notices:
  UnityDoorstop-4.3.0-source.zip.
  It contains no executable, DLL or PDB files. The upstream source is also
  available at:
  https://github.com/NeighTools/UnityDoorstop/tree/v4.3.0
  https://codeload.github.com/NeighTools/UnityDoorstop/zip/d061d7eabe9fc36140e7239955515801e2b9db12
  The library may be replaced with an interface-compatible modified build;
  replacement loader files must be managed separately from the installer's
  matching-official-file checks. No additional restriction is placed here
  on reverse engineering needed to debug modifications to this library.

LICENSE-PROVENANCE.json lists exact upstream text URLs, pinned revisions
and checksums. Bundled-Component-Versions.json records inspected DLL
versions and SHA-256 hashes against the official preloader archive.
